sources.title: RFC 9293: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP)
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: TCP RTO：平滑估計與最小計時限制
related.titleEn: TCP RTO: smoothing estimates and minimum-timer limits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受正確模2^32位元組覆蓋；超出半空間的排序問題需明確拒絕簡化判斷。 交接時須能核對：交付 tcp-sequence.csv、環形區間圖與FIN邊界測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require modulo-2^32 byte coverage and reject simplified ordering beyond half-space assumptions. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver tcp-sequence.csv, circular-range diagrams and a FIN boundary test.
related.difference: 分開記錄舊SRTT、更新RTTVAR、新SRTT、原始RTO與套下限後RTO。
related.differenceEn: Record old SRTT, updated RTTVAR, new SRTT, raw RTO and clamped RTO separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
TCP序號使用32位元環狀空間；確認號指向下一個期待位元組，SYN/FIN也各消耗序號。
教學基準：4294967280+40-2**32 = 24 sequence number；對照：4294967280+80-2**32 = 64 sequence number。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

RTO由SRTT與RTTVAR更新；變異更新先使用舊SRTT，並須再套計時器下限。
教學基準：(7/8*100+1/8*140)+4*(3/4*20+1/4*abs(100-140)) = 205 ms before minimum clamp；對照：(7/8*100+1/8*180)+4*(3/4*20+1/4*abs(100-180)) = 250 ms before minimum clamp。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
TCP uses a32-bit sequence space; ACK names the next expected byte, and SYN/FIN each consume a sequence number.
Teaching baseline: 4294967280+40-2**32 = 24 sequence number; comparison: 4294967280+80-2**32 = 64 sequence number. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

RTO updates SRTT and RTTVAR; variation uses the old SRTT first, followed by timer lower bounds.
Teaching baseline: (7/8*100+1/8*140)+4*(3/4*20+1/4*abs(100-140)) = 205 ms before minimum clamp; comparison: (7/8*100+1/8*180)+4*(3/4*20+1/4*abs(100-180)) = 250 ms before minimum clamp. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: QUIC：連線與串流雙層流量控制
related.titleEn: QUIC: connection and stream flow-control limits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受正確模2^32位元組覆蓋；超出半空間的排序問題需明確拒絕簡化判斷。 交接時須能核對：交付 tcp-sequence.csv、環形區間圖與FIN邊界測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require modulo-2^32 byte coverage and reject simplified ordering beyond half-space assumptions. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver tcp-sequence.csv, circular-range diagrams and a FIN boundary test.
related.difference: 按stream ID與最高offset建立帳本，計算連線與串流剩餘額度的最小值。
related.differenceEn: Ledger stream IDs and highest offsets and take the smaller remaining connection/stream credit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

教學基準：4294967280+40-2**32 = 24 sequence number；對照：4294967280+80-2**32 = 64 sequence number。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

QUIC的MAX_DATA限制整體資料，MAX_STREAM_DATA限制各串流；重傳同一offset不新增流量控制消耗。
教學基準：min(100000-80000,80000-30000) = 20000 new B；對照：min(150000-80000,80000-30000) = 50000 new B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

TCP uses a32-bit sequence space; ACK names the next expected byte, and SYN/FIN each consume a sequence number.
Teaching baseline: 4294967280+40-2**32 = 24 sequence number; comparison: 4294967280+80-2**32 = 64 sequence number. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

QUIC MAX_DATA limits aggregate data and MAX_STREAM_DATA limits each stream; retransmitting the same offsets consumes no additional credit.
Teaching baseline: min(100000-80000,80000-30000) = 20000 new B; comparison: min(150000-80000,80000-30000) = 50000 new B.
